method: Built-in image_gen, identity-preserving edits; originals kept.
base: Use case: background-extraction / identity-preserve. Edit the attached character as the exact fixed base model for a brand collaboration app. Preserve the new reference's large head, short body proportions, rose brown bob hair, face, dark eyes, pose, blue shirt, black knit vest, grey trousers, olive crossbody bag and sneakers EXACTLY. This reference has NO hat and NO glasses: do not add either. Isolate the complete single full body character on a genuinely transparent RGBA background, no floor or shadow outside feet, no text or extra objects. Center in portrait 2:3 canvas with small consistent margins above hair and under shoes. Premium soft 3D toy render with crisp clothing detail. This is the base for later product try-on.

variants.change: Add a chunky knitted cobalt-blue scarf around the neck with a short loose tail over the vest, illustrating a fictional recycled-textile brand's scarf product. Keep the existing clothes and olive bag.
